items.title: AI發展與普及速度受制於安全性不足，SailPoint創辦人呼籲整個產業持續投入並付諸行動
items.summary: 近期頂尖AI模型服務失控事件引發關注，日前造訪香港的SailPoint執行長暨創辦人Mark McClain表示，AI不會也不該停下發展的腳步，關鍵在於設法提升AI安全性。他也談到該公司提倡的適應性身分，這是為了因應動態環境即時處理需求而發展的身分防護機制。最後，為了讓大家理解AI與安全性之間的關係，他特別用F1賽車為喻，指出煞車是否完善，是影響跑車能否發揮速度的關鍵，AI也是如此。

items.title: fix(agents): return the full sessions_send reply past the terminal sn…
items.summary: fix(agents): return the full sessions_send reply past the terminal snapshot bound (#175685) * fix(agents): return the full sessions_send reply past the terminal snapshot bound A waiting sessions_send returned the run's terminal reply snapshot, which is bounded to 4,096 characters, so long peer replies were cut with no signal. When the reply sits at the bound, read the accepted run's own stored reply by run id; if that is unavailable, keep the bounded text and report replyTruncated with a pointer to sessions_history. * fix(agents): detect truncated sessions_send replies by marker, not length Truncation trims the whole retained prefix before its marker, so a cut reply can be far shorter than the bound (4,000 characters + 100 spaces + TAIL becomes 4,000 characters + marker). Treat any reply ending in the marker as possibly cut and let the accepted run's stored reply decide: it extends the prefix (recover it) or equals it (a reply that really ends in an ellipsis). * fix(agents): recover complete inline session replies Reuse the existing run-filtered reply reader and canonical snapshot sanitizer, remove the extra recovery helpers, and disclose unavailable or budget-limited reply text without suggesting that the original task be repeated. Keep the strict output schema and session-tool docs consistent with the result. Related: #175597 Original fix by @wr-web; maintainer cleanup preserves the inline-only scope. Co-authored-by: Wang Rui --------- Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger Co-authored-by: Wang Rui

items.title: fix(ui): Usage shows unknown totals and hides analytics when one resp…
items.summary: fix(ui): Usage shows unknown totals and hides analytics when one response ends early (#176404) * fix(ui): show Usage totals as lower bounds when a response ended early One interrupted response made the whole range read "unknown" and hid the chart and every analytics section. The known subtotal is a lower bound: totals now read "≥ value", the analytics stay visible with a note that explains the bound, and usage with no known price reads "Unpriced" instead of $0.00. * test(ui): give the unpriced provider fixture its message count * fix(ui): mark every restored Usage analytic as exact, lower bound, or unknown With analytics no longer hidden for interrupted ranges, partial sums in the daily chart, type breakdown, cost windows, Started by, activity and heatmap now carry the lower-bound marker. Ratios built from partial counters (per-message averages, throughput, cache hit rate) show as unknown, and cost shares are hidden while the overall total is a lower bound.
